newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open little changed Wednesday in line with LME copper which was steady as both markets continue the past week's consolidation near six-month highs.
COMEX March copper was called unchanged to up 0.20 cent from Tuesday's close of 106.25 cents a lb. It traded from 106.25 to 107.25 on ACCESS.
COMEX warehouse copper stocks fell 767 short tons Tuesday to 20,523 short tons. LME stocks rose 4,725 tonnes to 143,225 tonnes Tuesday.
Metal has been moving from COMEX warehouses to LME warehouses in both the US and Singapore, analysts said.
Spot LME copper retains its premium over COMEX copper, though COMEX March copper is trading at a premium to LME March copper, analysts noted.

Prospects for a seasonal upturn in demand in the first quarter, boosted by accelerating global economic growth, and very tight inventories of refined copper are likely to sustain the recent gains in copper prices though, analysts said.
